changes.name: h5_priority_rows
changes.complete_raw_header:
theorem h5_priority_rows (i : Fin 7) (t : Point) :
    evalRow (row (.h5 i) 36) t =
      P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.D23 t-P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.H1 t ∧
    evalRow (row (.h5 i) 37) t =
      P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.D23 t-P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.H3 t ∧
    evalRow (row (.h5 i) 18) t =
      P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.H5 t-P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.D23 t :=
changes.before_body:
fin_cases i
  all_goals repeat' constructor
  all_goals norm_num [row,evalRow,Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.h5AffineRows,
    P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.D23,P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.D,
    P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.H1,P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.H3,
    P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.H5] <;> ring
changes.after_body:
fin_cases i
  all_goals repeat' constructor
  all_goals norm_num only [
    row, rowCount, evalRow, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_zero',
    Matrix.cons_val_succ, Matrix.cons_val_succ', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
    Fin.succ, Fin.instOfNat, Fin.ofNat, Fin.Internal.ofNat,
    Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_mk, Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, Nat.reduceMod,
    Rat.cast_zero, Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_neg, Rat.cast_add, Rat.cast_sub,
    Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_ofNat,
    P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.h5AffineRows,
    P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.D23,P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.D,
    P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.H1,P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.H3,
    P4AOriginalFirstFailureH5H7Literal.H5]
    <;> first | rfl | ring1!
